dispositions.rationale: The migrated-install compatibility branch preserves BookshelfNG audiobook candidate order: profile quality and revision, custom-format score, preferred protocol, indexer priority, torrent peers, book count, Usenet age, and size rounded to 200 MB. Fresh installs and mixed ebook/audiobook comparisons retain ChaptarrNG ranking. This records the source-code port only; converted-library acceptance remains open.
